text: As the Stanley Greene subdivision approaches completion and the new residential units become occupied, vehicular and pedestrian traffic within the neighbourhood has rapidly increased. As a result, my office has heard from several members of the community which are requesting more effective road safety measures. The request comes after collisions and close calls became more frequent in the neighbourhood as of late. The roads and sidewalks within the Stanley Greene subdivision have yet to be assumed by the City. While we wait for the assumption process to unfold, my office believes that these pressing traffic safety issues must be addressed as soon as possible.
